title: Ricci-harmonic flow of $\mathrm{G}_2$ and Spin(7)-structures
summary: We introduce and study a new general flow of $\mathrm{G}_2$-structures which we call the Ricci-harmonic flow of $\mathrm{G}_2$-structures. The flow is the coupling of the Ricci flow of underlying metrics and the isometric flow of $\mathrm{G}_2$-structures, but we also provide explicit lower order in the torsion terms. The lower order terms and the flow are obtained by analyzing the second order term in the Taylor series expansion of $\mathrm{G}_2$-structures in normal coordinates.
